name: A Conversation with Mister Rabbit
source:
An aspiring knight meets with a rabbit in the forest to find peace with himself. Will he move forward with his life, or will he be unable to forgive his own mistakes? 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556610/A_Conversation_With_Mister_Rabbit/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一位有抱负的骑士在森林里遇见了一只兔子，以寻求内心的平静。他会继续自己的生活，还是无法原谅自己的错误？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1556610/A_Conversation_With_Mister_Rabbit/]Steam[/url]]
